name: mldr-r1
cmd:
set -uo pipefail
log=$(mktemp /tmp/lane-i-rebased-mldr-r1.XXXXXX.log)
bash research/lane-i/validate.sh mldr 1 mldr >"$log" 2>&1
status=$?
printf 'LANE_I_CAPTURE_GZIP '
gzip -n -c "$log" | base64 -w0
printf '\nLANE_I_CAPTURE_META '
printf '{"exit":%s,"path":"%s","sha256":"%s"}\n' "$status" "$log" "$(sha256sum "$log" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
exit "$status"
